scenes.caption: Stagepay keeps work and its test-payment decisions together.
This walkthrough uses real local contracts and demo roles.

Split the work into two payments: 10 and 20 DEMO.

Fund the agreement and wait for its confirmed receipt.
Switch to the freelancer and agree to the exact scope.

Both agree. The first 10 DEMO remains available as credit.
Withdraw the accepted payment. Unpaid work stays in escrow.
